# Auth method Rego builtin checkpoint

- Goal achieved: `flipt.is_auth_method(input, method)` is registered for Rego policies with seven allowed labels mapped to generated auth protobuf enum constants. `k8s` and `kubernetes` share the Kubernetes enum value.

- Added direct builtin tests and an engine policy test using a protobuf authentication object and role metadata.

+package ext
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+// authMethods uses the generated protobuf enum values to keep policy labels in
+// sync with the authentication methods accepted by the server.
+var authMethods = map[string]auth.Method{
+	"token":      auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+	"oidc":       auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+	"kubernetes": auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"k8s":        auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"github":     auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+	"jwt":        auth.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+	"cloud":      auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+}
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name:        "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Description: "Reports whether input.authentication.method matches token, oidc, kubernetes (or k8s), github, jwt, or cloud.",
+		Decl: types.NewFunction([]types.Type{
+			types.NewObject(nil, types.NewDynamicProperty(types.NewString(), types.NewAny())),
+			types.NewString(),
+		}, types.NewBoolean()),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	authentication := input.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil || authentication.Equal(ast.NullTerm()) {
+		return nil, rego.NewHaltError(fmt.Errorf("no authentication found"))
+	}
+
+	methodName, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, rego.NewHaltError(fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %v", key.Value))
+	}
+
+	method, ok := authMethods[string(methodName)]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, rego.NewHaltError(fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", string(methodName)))
+	}
+
+	actual := authentication.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(actual != nil && actual.Equal(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(method)))), nil
+}

+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		label  string
+		method auth.Method
+	}{
+		{"token", auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
+		{"oidc", auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC},
+		{"kubernetes", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"k8s", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"github", auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB},
+		{"jwt", auth.Method_METHOD_JWT},
+		{"cloud", auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.label, func(t *testing.T) {
+			input := authMethodInput(tt.method)
+			result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(tt.label))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(true), result)
+
+			result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, authMethodInput(auth.Method_METHOD_NONE), ast.StringTerm(tt.label))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), result)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, input := range []*ast.Term{
+		ast.ObjectTerm(),
+		ast.NewTerm(ast.MustInterfaceToValue(map[string]any{"authentication": nil})),
+	} {
+		result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm("token"))
+		require.Nil(t, result)
+		require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.NewTerm(ast.MustInterfaceToValue(map[string]any{
+		"authentication": map[string]any{},
+	})), ast.StringTerm("token"))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), result)
+
+	result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, authMethodInput(auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN), ast.StringTerm("password"))
+	require.Nil(t, result)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported auth method: password")
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodSignature(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, query := range []string{
+		`flipt.is_auth_method(input)`,
+		`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "token", "extra")`,
+		`flipt.is_auth_method(input, 1)`,
+	} {
+		t.Run(query, func(t *testing.T) {
+			_, err := rego.New(rego.Query(query)).PrepareForEval(context.Background())
+			require.Error(t, err)
+			require.True(t, strings.Contains(err.Error(), "flipt.is_auth_method"), err.Error())
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func authMethodInput(method auth.Method) *ast.Term {
+	return ast.NewTerm(ast.MustInterfaceToValue(map[string]any{
+		"authentication": map[string]any{"method": int(method)},
+	}))
+}

+func TestEngine_AuthMethodPolicy(t *testing.T) {
+	const policy = `package flipt.authz.v1
+import rego.v1
+default allow := false
+allow if {
+	flipt.is_auth_method(input, "k8s")
+	input.authentication.metadata["io.flipt.auth.role"] == "admin"
+}`
+
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	engine, err := newEngine(ctx, zaptest.NewLogger(t), withPolicySource(policySource(policy)))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name     string
+		method   authrpc.Method
+		role     string
+		expected bool
+	}{
+		{"matching admin", authrpc.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES, "admin", true},
+		{"different role", authrpc.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES, "viewer", false},
+		{"different method", authrpc.Method_METHOD_JWT, "admin", false},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			allowed, err := engine.IsAllowed(ctx, map[string]any{
+				"authentication": &authrpc.Authentication{
+					Method:   tt.method,
+					Metadata: map[string]string{"io.flipt.auth.role": tt.role},
+				},
+			})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.expected, allowed)
+		})
+	}
+
+	methodOnlyEngine, err := newEngine(ctx, zaptest.NewLogger(t), withPolicySource(policySource(`package flipt.authz.v1
+import rego.v1
+allow if { flipt.is_auth_method(input, "token") }`)))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = methodOnlyEngine.IsAllowed(ctx, map[string]any{})
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	invalidEngine, err := newEngine(ctx, zaptest.NewLogger(t), withPolicySource(policySource(`package flipt.authz.v1
+import rego.v1
+allow if { flipt.is_auth_method(input, "password") }`)))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = invalidEngine.IsAllowed(ctx, map[string]any{"authentication": &authrpc.Authentication{Method: authrpc.Method_METHOD_TOKEN}})
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unsupported auth method: password")
+}
